rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking in liquid, energy, or information, and for organizational incorporation or assimilation.

example.english: I need time to absorb this information.
example.traditional: 我需要時間吸收呢啲資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 kap1 sau1 ni1 di1 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this when something occupies all or most of someone’s time, attention, or thoughts.

example.english: This report seems to absorb all my time this week.
example.traditional: 呢份報告佔據咗我成個星期嘅時間。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zim3 geoi3 zo2 ngo5 seng4 go3 sing1 kei4 ge3 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this for a liquid or substance gradually sinking or soaking into another substance.

example.english: The rainwater slowly starts to absorb into the soil.
example.jyutping: di1 jyu5 seoi2 maan6 maan6 sam3 jap6 nai4 tou2

rows.note: Use this in commercial contexts when a seller or company agrees to cover a particular cost.

example.english: This shop will absorb the shipping cost.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 baau1 maai4 wan6 fai3
